title: Stage 5 identity role-change policy transition v1
description: Immutable transition record for replacing a verifier-pinned identity role-change policy, with approval under the prior policy and a separately signed verifier pin update.
$comment: approved_intent_sha256 is SHA-256(JCS({schema,transition_id,environment_id,log_id,policy_id,previous_policy_version,previous_policy_sha256,next_policy_version,next_policy_sha256,expected_pin_revision,previous_pin_sha256,actor_subject_id,approver_subject_id})). The transition approval signature covers JCS({approval_id,approver_subject_id,approver_signing_key_id,approved_intent_sha256,signed_at_utc,signature_profile}) using ed25519-jcs-identity-policy-transition-approval-v1. transition_approval_sha256 in the pin update and next policy is SHA-256(JCS(the complete transition_approval object)). The pin update signature covers JCS({pin_authority_id,pin_revision,transition_record_id,transition_approval_sha256,previous_pin_sha256,next_pin_sha256,applied_at_utc,signature_profile,signing_key_id}) using ed25519-jcs-verifier-policy-pin-update-v1. record_sha256 is SHA-256(JCS(the record with record_sha256 and signature omitted)); the record signature covers JCS({schema,record_sha256,recorded_at_utc,signature_profile,signing_key_id}) using ed25519-jcs-identity-policy-transition-v1. Semantic verification requires identical policy id/environment/log scope, next version = previous version + 1, previous digest and pin equal current trusted state, next pin equal the new policy digest, expected pin revision and update revision be consecutive, transition approval be authorized under the previous policy and bind the exact proposed update, and the pin authority be independently pinned from the identity source. Schema validation does not verify signatures, digests, role status, monotonicity, or trust-domain separation.
